name: Equipment supplier code
description: Code specifying the party that is the supplier of the equipment.

values.name: Shipper supplied
values.description: Shipper supplied The transport equipment is supplied by the shipper.

values.name: Carrier supplied
values.description: Carrier supplied The transport equipment is supplied by the carrier.

values.name: Consolidator supplied
values.description: Consolidator supplied The equipment is supplied by the consolidator.

values.name: Deconsolidator supplied
values.description: Deconsolidator supplied The equipment is supplied by the deconsolidator.

values.name: Third party supplied
values.description: Third party supplied The equipment is supplied by a third party.

values.name: Forwarder supplied from a leasing company
values.description: Forwarder supplied from a leasing company The equipment is supplied by the forwarder and is taken from a leasing company.

values.name: Forwarder supplied from the railways' pool
values.description: Forwarder supplied from the railways' pool The equipment is supplied by the forwarder and is taken from a pool established by railway companies.
